messages:
Carol (SRE): quick follow-up from last night's postmortem for the cross-region routing + TLS retry surge. I'm consolidating action items and owners here so we can drive the sprint work. Short thread, pls ack and add blockers.

Carol (SRE): tl;dr: transient SNI mismatch + a routing sticky-path bug caused retries to amplify across regions. Root cause timeline and perf numbers in the doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/cr-2026-routing-tls-surge (see timeline and traces).

Carol (SRE): Action items I'm proposing (with tentative timelines). Please claim or reassign: 
1) Fix sticky-route mismatch in LB routing table (root cause: route hash collision on multi-host backend). Owner: unassigned. ETA: 2w for patch + 1w for rollout validation.
2) TLS handshake retry backoff tuning and client-side guardrail (reduce early retries, add jitter). Owner: unassigned. ETA: 3d for config change, 2w for monitoring.
3) Add SNI/ALPN mismatch probe and dashboard (detect before customer impact). Owner: unassigned. ETA: 1w.
4) Update runbooks + incident playbook to include cross-region routing fallback and rollback steps. Owner: me (Carol). ETA: 3d.
5) Longtail retry pattern forensic analysis + synthetic workload to reproduce (logging + load test). Owner: unassigned. ETA: 2w.

Ben K: I'll take #1 (LB routing sticky-path). I'll start a fork and a spec PR today. ETA: patch by 2026-04-12, rollout the following week.

Alice M: I'll take #2 (TLS retry/backoff). Quick note: client SDKs also need a tiny bump to prefer exponential with cap + jitter. I'll open SDK PR and ops playbook change.

Dave (Eng-Platform): I'll own #3 (probes + dashboard). I'll add a region-aware probe that validates SNI/ALPN during circuit setup and push to telemetry. Estimate 5 business days.

Elaine (Networking): For #5 longtail analysis — I'll coordinate with BenchTeam. Need access to sampled KV cache traces. Can infra grant a temporary export? @DevInfraBot tagging for retention/export.

DevInfraBot: @Elaine (Networking) I created support ticket INFRA-5923 to export kv-cache-samples with 7d retention. Link: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/INFRA-5923 :white_check_mark:

Ben K: FYI, patch will include additional hash salt option to avoid route collisions. Putting design note here:
```
- Add route_salt per backend group
- fallback to round-robin when salt mismatch detected
- telemetry: emit route_hash and backend_id for 1% sampling
```

Alice M: Quick measurement: on synthetic tests reducing retry immediate attempts from 3->1 dropped amplified retries by ~63%. We'll want to be cautious about client-visible latency, but it's promising.

Carol (SRE): Good. Owners: #1 Ben, #2 Alice, #3 Dave, #4 Carol, #5 Elaine. Let's confirm timelines inline: Ben (2w), Alice (3d->2w validation), Dave (1w), Carol (3d), Elaine (2w). If any timeline is optimistic, call it out now.

Ben K: timelines look fine. I'll add a canary plan for multi-region slow-rollout. Need Eng-SRE to reserve canary capacity.

Dave (Eng-Platform): noted, I'll request canary pool via infra ticket and link here when ready.

Alice M: SDK bump will be a minor version; I'll coordinate with SDK release process. Plan to land config change behind a feature flag first.

Elaine (Networking): Can we add a short-term mitigation we can flip quickly if we see amplification? e.g., region-pref routing cap or emergency reject threshold.

Carol (SRE): yes — short-term mitigation proposal: implement region-pref cap at LB layer + dynamic reject threshold that triggers at 5% incremental retries. Ben, can your LB patch add feature flags to enable that quickly?

Ben K: I can add flags. Will include emergency toggle endpoints in the PR.

Carol (SRE): Next steps: owners please add your task to the postmortem issues board with acceptance criteria and link the PRs. I'll run a weekly 15m standup on Tuesdays to track progress until all items are done. First standup: next Tue 10:30am PT.

Alice M: Acked. I'll create SDK + ops PRs and link.

DevInfraBot: Reminder set: weekly check-in scheduled (Tues 10:30am PT) — calendar invites sent to participants.

Carol (SRE): Anything else? If not, :thumbsup: to acknowledge ownership and timelines so I can update the postmortem with the action tracker.

Ben K: :thumbsup:

Alice M: :thumbsup:

Dave (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup:

Elaine (Networking): :thumbsup: will update INFRA-5923 with data request details.

Carol (SRE): Thanks all. I'll update the doc with owners + timelines now and ping product + SE for customer comms if rollout looks risky.
